def _prefill(self, ids: list[int], seq: int, start: int = 0) -> int:
    pilot = getattr(self, "pilot", None)
    learning = getattr(pilot, "learning", None)
    # This variant is scoped to the measured CPU runtime, GGUF, four-core geometry and scratch head.
    switch = (len(ids) - start > 1
              and getattr(learning, "binding", None) == "2f66fab88eeb1c6f3c974912e0f3d183c065a6eabaf6d768f3ffb74b24e13d50"
              and (learning.candidate_status or {}).get("sha256") == "f66700d1593befeee7f01c9835606c644bebd3b2ca6aeb1bbb36c81b9157def0"
              and learning.weights and self.gpu_layers == 0 and self.threads < pilot.cores)
    if switch:
        previous_threads, poll = self.threads, getattr(self, "poll", POLL)
    first = None
    try:
        if switch:
            self.set_threads(pilot.cores, poll)
        for start in range(start, len(ids), self.seq_ctx):
            chunk = ids[start:start + self.seq_ctx]
            last = start + len(chunk) == len(ids)
            rows = [(t, start + j, seq, last and j == len(chunk) - 1) for j, t in enumerate(chunk)]
            observer = self.observer
            if observer is not None:
                started = time.perf_counter()
            picks = self._decode(rows)
            if observer is not None:
                observer(0, len(chunk), start, time.perf_counter() - started)
            first = picks[-1] if picks else first
        return first
    finally:
        if switch:
            self.set_threads(previous_threads, poll)
proposal.rationale: The four matched discovery waves attribute 68–74% of short/document wall time to native prefill while fewer than four CPU threads were active. Temporarily use all four already assigned cores for a multi-token single-sequence prefill on the specific EPYC/SmolLM2 learner binding, only after the matching scratch checkpoint has a locally admitted decode choice. Keep the original chunking, token positions, final-logit selection and per-chunk observer, and restore the previous thread count and polling level in a finally block on every exit, including decode or observer errors. Use one switch per call, including when the call spans several chunks. Unmatched hosts, model/configurations, checkpoints, single-token calls and unqualified learners take the original path. Native pool reattachment costs and memory bandwidth can erase the benefit. The complete six paired serving waves and the unchanged all-thread competitor must decide.
